newsitem.title: MEXICO: Geo in final stages of Eurobond road show.
newsitem.headline: Geo in final stages of Eurobond road show.

text.p: Mexican builder Corporacion Geo is in the final steps of its road show for its planned Eurobond, which is expected to be worth $50 million, a company official said on Friday.
The company hopes to place the five-year issue this month, the source said.
The official said it was unlikely the issue will be increased to $75 million, as has been rumored.
MMS International said in a report that the bond had been priced at 99.892 (350 basis points over or 10.028 percent).
